id: title:georgemunyoro:cache database sources for editor assist queries

review.posthog_relevance: Adds HogQL database source caching capability, potentially reducing warehouse load and latency for metadata retrieval.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F6.H2 demonstrates the implementation of a shared cache and the passing of the `use_cached_sources` parameter, establishing the mechanism to reuse warehouse sources. P1.F3.H3 adds the parameter definition. While P1.F3.H3 lacks the full implementation and P1.F5 shows only setup, P1.F6.H2 provides sufficient evidence of the bounded capability and relevant checks to merit
review.uncertainty: The chunk P1.F3.H3 does not show the complete implementation of the cache or the database changes, and P1.F5 lacks actual cache behavior, leaving some implementation details unverified. The tier is assigned based on P1.F6.H2, but the full realization of the benefit depends on the missing implementation in P1.F3 and P1.F5.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the cache, the complete HogQLDatabaseSources class, or the complete database.py file. The P1.F3.H3 hunk only shows a parameter addition without its implementation. P1.F5.H1 and P1.F5.H2 show test setup and imports, but not the actual cache behavior or the database changes. P1.F4.H1 shows the cache implementation, but P1.F3.
